# HoneyHarmony

> HoneyHarmony is a Liquid Wellness Supplement (Drops). HoneyHarmony Drops is a liquid supplement built around a honey-inspired identity rather than a capsule routine. It is presented as a convenient dropper-style formula for everyday use, aimed at people who prefer to skip pills and want something quick to take. Because the branding leans on honey, the product is positioned in the general wellness space as a simple daily add-on — not a treatment for any medical condition. It is sold online in multi-bottle packages through the official order page.
